anchors.description: Floor to countertop top front edge of the white bathroom vanity
anchors.visible_evidence: White vanity with dark granite top; floor tile is visible at the cabinet-front base directly below the counter front top edge (same x=530).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Vanity could be 32-in (0.81 m) or 36-in (0.91 m) height; decorative ball feet instead of a toe kick and the counter overhang add 1-2 cm; floor point is the visible tile just in front of the cabinet.

anchors.description: Clear width between the two jamb inner edges of the dark interior doorway
anchors.visible_evidence: Dark doorway leading to a stair landing; both door-jamb inner edges are visible at the same height (x=190 and x=245 at y=150).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be a standard 30-in or 32-in door opening or a narrower closet passage; jamb faces are seen slightly obliquely, so the imaged span is mildly foreshortened.

anchors.description: Height of the wall-mounted switch/outlet plate on the left wall
anchors.visible_evidence: Small rectangular plate mounted on the wall left of the doorway; full plate outline (top and bottom edges) visible at x~116-131, y~121-138.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Plate might be a switch, outlet cover, or thermostat; at this blur the visible rectangle could be the plate (4.5 in) or partly the switch window, which would shorten the length toward 0.07 m.
